title: Wizard view v1 — objectui alignment + pins for the ruled tightening (Card R, follows objectstack Card S)
body:
Card R of the objectstack#13342 chain, filed by the domain:spec seat (`session_01PBjwYLS6BciTQW3c9xQiD2`) per the maintainer ruling of 2026-08-31 on objectstack#13622 (director batch #12, verbatim 「同意」). Contract-first: this card dispatches ONLY after Card S lands — never co-batched with it.

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#13704

## Scope (re-price at dispatch against the tree — the proposal already measured the renderer as largely landed)

- Align objectui's own declarations/mirrors with the ruled `type:'wizard'` tightening where they restate the form-view family (measure first: the proposal found WizardForm, the leave-step validation gate, and the progress model already implemented — the expected residue is alignment + pins, not new rendering).
- Pin the ruled semantics from the consumer side: the wizard-inert step keys refused at the spec door are not silently consumed by WizardForm; empty-sections refusal; `allowSkip` = navigation freedom not validation exemption; array order = step order.
- ⚠️ Installability gate (standing lane rule): any test asserting the INSTALLED `@objectstack/spec` refuses the tightened shapes waits for a spec release carrying Card S — keep such assertions off the local suite or gate them on the installed version, and say which in the PR.
- ⛔ No teaching material — the #13337/#13086 fence lifts only after BOTH halves land; the layout-dsl "declared way is tabbed" sentence (F2) is the post-landing teaching card's, not this one's.

Closes the #13342 chain together with Card S; the parent stays the coordination node until both land.

Refs: objectstack#13622 (design + ruling of record) · objectstack#13704 (Card S) · #6237 (ruled type-split this upgrades).
